authority: User instruction: activate after current step-time and accuracy goals are reached and verified; later phases depend on all earlier phases succeeding.
candidate_inference: Full AI, complete physical states including every intermediate step; numerical solvers are offline teachers and controls only.

phases.requirement: Finish original registered targets, seed characterization, reserved-scene evaluation and complete application studies. A development median pass alone does not activate the follow-on.
phases.evidence: completion-audit.json and original immutable scientific bindings

reference_grid.question: Use 32 cubed as the reference, or retain the current smaller-grid benchmark with 32 cubed separate?
reference_grid.rule: Freeze reference dimensions and voxel count before fitting/scaling claims; existing 32-cubed performance is not a 1.2 ms pass.

proposed_measurement_contract.cpu: One CPU thread, batch size one, fixed recorded affinity and comparable hardware; five balanced serial repeats.
proposed_measurement_contract.maximum_interpretation: Maximum observed complete block latency divided by K across the registered finite population; also publish median and p95. Empirical maximum, not a hard real-time guarantee.
proposed_measurement_contract.timing_scope: Encoding, known forcing, all neural compute, complete physical reconstruction and required history updates. Report full application, setup, cache preparation and memory separately.
proposed_measurement_contract.accuracy_scope: Equation residual plus pressure, velocity and tracer errors for every intermediate horizon and autonomous history through the registered 240-step interval. Preserve failures and diagnostics.
proposed_measurement_contract.near_zero_fields: Freeze training-only scales and absolute tolerances appropriate to 1e-5; do not carry the old 4e-3 absolute tolerances into a tighter accuracy claim.
proposed_measurement_contract.confirmation: Freeze splits, selection, precision, sources and additional-seed work before fitting; evaluate fresh reserved scenes.

research_options: Profile complete inference and reduce measured expensive work while checking every physical output.
Tune compact learned pressure/dynamics components against actual current checkpoints.
Compare shared multi-horizon decoding, accurate learned endpoints with learned intermediate decoding, and causal feature reuse. Count all outputs and required computation.

phases.requires: Phase 1 passes for all four K values
phases.logical_dimensions: Random aspect ratios, including all-below, all-above and mixed-axis dimensions relative to 50 or 100 at the corresponding density. Cells per metre differ from logical grid counts and fluid mass density.
phases.dataset_preparation: Pilot capture time, memory, disk, native references and timestep stability; freeze finite size caps, scenes and budgets afterward. Retain smaller regimes for regression. Split whole scenes and reserve shapes including odd rectangles.
phases.larger_grid_timing_formula: maximum_ms_per_generated_step = 1.2 * (Nx * Ny * Nz) / V_reference; maximum_block_ms = K * maximum_ms_per_generated_step
phases.smaller_grid_interpretation: Retain the 1.2 ms base cap unless separately specified; proportional allowance applies to increases in voxel count.
phases.scaling_objective: Prefer growth below the voxel-proportional ceiling. Measure per-voxel cost and scaling for matched-aspect families against native Rheon controls; separate aspect-ratio effects. No extrapolated passes.

phases.requires: Both preceding model target phases succeed for all K values and registered larger sizes/densities
phases.proposed_rate_interpretation: 600 actual integration steps at each rate with matched native references; decimated 60 Hz rendering is not 30 Hz integration. Extend and qualify the current fixed-dt native/model contract first.
phases.objective: Minimize measured drift while preserving prior accuracy and timing constraints. Score every physical state and autonomous block continuation without reference resets.
phases.reporting: Worst cases, complete curves, finite failures and scene/seed variability for every K. Report best measured drift, not a global optimum. Freeze finite trial budgets and stopping rules at activation.

execution_rules.learning: Managed Tuldok CUDA fits with typed exact CPU restores using the existing authorized owner workflow.
execution_rules.immutability: Separate conditional program; does not replace the original frozen plan, relax criteria or alter existing evidence.
execution_rules.next_registration: Resolve reference-grid choice; freeze concrete data, numerical, training, evaluation and resource contracts before phase 1 execution.
